details:
Since the latest update (Build 1885), you can no longer send a Request Invite

to a friend who is in a joinable instance (Friends / Friends+) — only "Join"

is shown.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Have a friend join a Friends or Friends+ instance (an instance you are able to join)

2. Open their user detail page from the Social menu

3. Look for the "Request Invite" option

## Expected Behavior

"Request Invite" is available alongside "Join", as in previous builds.

## Actual Behavior

Only "Join" is available. There is no way to send a Request Invite.

## Why this matters

Even when an instance is technically joinable, many users send a Request

Invite first to ask "is now a good time to join?" instead of jumping in

directly. This usage is especially well-established in the Japanese community.

The friend may be in the middle of a conversation, an event, or taking

photos. There are many situations where you want to check whether it's okay

to join right now — for example, to avoid running into someone you'd rather

not meet who happens to be in the same instance.

Please bring back the ability to send Request Invites in this situation.
title: Can no longer send Request Invite to friends in joinable instances
